subject: music

moments.title: Grand Tour
moments.body: Leopold Mozart takes his children Wolfgang (7) and Nannerl on a three-year tour of European courts.
moments.takeaway: Mozart's career was launched by his father's promotional strategy.

moments.title: Le nozze di Figaro
moments.body: Mozart and Da Ponte adapt Beaumarchais's politically charged comedy.

moments.title: Mozart dies
moments.body: Mozart dies at 35, leaving the Requiem unfinished. The myth of poisoning is later exploded.
moments.takeaway: Romantic biographies often mythologise Classical composers.

now.title: Mozart now
now.body: Mozart's complete works are available free online (NMA). His operas are foundational to international repertoire.
now.open_questions: How do we square Mozart's biography with the music?

reflection: Mozart's catalogue at 35 is larger than many composers' at 80.
